profile_key.migration_or_pool_destination: PumpSwap for current standard lifecycle; verify event-native completion/migration rather than infer from an aggregator

mechanics.launch_path: Create -> bonding-curve trading -> completion/migration lifecycle -> PumpSwap trading. Native create/trade/completion events are preferred evidence.
mechanics.bonding_curve_or_initial_pool_mechanics: Venue-native curve state is authoritative for early lifecycle research. Do not substitute later DEX snapshots for launch-time state.
mechanics.graduation_or_migration_condition: Treat completion/migration as an event-defined lifecycle transition. Historical market-cap or virtual-reserve proxies are not graduation proof.
mechanics.creator_self_buy_mechanics: Initial creator buy is observable and should be analysed categorically/non-monotonically; no monotonic positive weight is authorized.
mechanics.creator_fee_or_reward_mechanics: Creator economics changed across 2026 and may change behaviour; version as a regime variable rather than silently pool across eras.
mechanics.lp_creation_and_lock_or_burn_semantics: Post-completion execution is a different liquidity state from the bonding curve and must be modelled separately.
mechanics.quote_asset_and_price_unit: Custom-pair support means quoteMint is explicit and raw quote amounts must retain their native unit until normalized.
mechanics.typical_initial_liquidity_topology: Bonding-curve state before completion; do not apply constant post-DEX liquidity assumptions.

base_rate_rule: These rates are deliberately not collapsed into one Solana number. Selection, observation horizon, regime and outcome semantics differ materially.

market_structure.launch_frequency: HIGH; use denominator-complete/event-native capture where possible rather than newest-N polling.
market_structure.candidate_age_interpretation: Age must be measured against immutable origin/create evidence. Observer timestamp error and pool-age substitution are known failure modes.
market_structure.market_cap_semantics: Explicitly distinguish market cap, FDV and curve/implied valuation. Virtual-reserve-derived values cannot stand in for real reserves or completion state.
market_structure.liquidity_semantics: Curve liquidity/execution and PumpSwap liquidity/execution are different lifecycle states.
market_structure.holder_breadth: Raw holders are not independent economic entities; bundle/funder/router/entity adjustment is required.
market_structure.execution: Sellability, slippage and exit capacity are separate from chart price and theoretical peak.

hard_non_inferences: Many wallets does not imply many independent buyers.
Persistent co-entry does not imply insider control.
Graduation does not imply profitable or sellable tail outcome.
Social presence does not imply organic propagation.
A high chart peak does not imply realizable return.

wallet_context.minimum_asof_history_for_specialist_labe: TO_BE_CALIBRATED_PROSPECTIVELY; history must be matured before candidate cutoff

lifecycle_clocks.runner_confirmation_hypothesis: 3m/5m/10m survival is retained as a hypothesis only; no production threshold until prospective replication.
lifecycle_clocks.completion: Use event-native completion state, not market-cap proxy.
lifecycle_clocks.post_completion: Treat PumpSwap runner/distribution behaviour as a separate stage.
lifecycle_clocks.phoenix: Re-entry after drawdown is a separate lifecycle model and must not share early-launch training labels by default.

regime_break_conditions: supported quote assets or quote-asset mix changes materially
bot/bundle/entity environment shifts enough to alter feature prevalence
tail-event base rate changes materially in prospective cohort
